negative: cartoon, CGI, 3D render, plastic look, deformed hands, extra fingers, fused fingers, warped or melting objects, text, watermark, logo, subtitles, oversaturated colors, blur, flicker, jump cuts, fast shaky camera

shots.note: Already made (hands knead the dough ball on floured marble).

shots.prompt: High-angle close-up. The hands stretch the dough outward on the floured marble, turning it a little with each move, forming a thin round base with a soft, puffy rim. The dough is supple and slightly translucent in the light. Slow, smooth orbit around the dough. Setting: a warm artisan pizzeria kitchen — white marble counter dusted with flour, white painted brick wall, light oak shelves, brass cone pendant lamps, and a copper-domed wood-fired oven glowing softly in the background. Style: photorealistic cinematic food commercial, shot on ARRI Alexa with a 50mm macro lens, shallow depth of field, creamy bokeh, warm golden practical light, natural colors, real-world physics, subtle film grain, 24fps. One continuous shot, no cuts, no text, no music.
